Patch Set 3:

(1 comment)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Looks good; the wakeup fixes the delay before the first precreate. One optional commit-message note inline, no need to re-spin just for it. A regression test isn't strictly needed, but a check in sanity-pfl/conf-sanity that objects are precreated soon after mount (well under opd_statfs_maxage) would guard against this coming back.

commit.subject: LU-20851 osp: wake up precreate if status changes.
commit.message:
LU-20851 osp: wake up precreate if status changes.

OSP begins with precreate status = -EAGAIN and the precreate thread
is waiting for the status to change to start precreation activity.
the status is changed by statfs updates which. so it's possible that
enters wait queue for 5s, but osp_statfs_interpret() doesn't wake it
up, so we lose 5s after mount.

the precreate thread waits for opd_pre_status == 0, so wake it up
whenever the status changes, e.g. -EAGAIN after mount or -ENODEV
after reconnect.

Fixes: 160392c3b0d1 ("LU-1303 osp: land precreate code")
